summary: Practise ethical workplace influence, proposal framing and objection handling. Explore the five-day course and see how it fits your role.
lede: Influence and persuasion training helps professionals make clear, ethical requests when they need agreement or action at work. It is designed for project leads, team supervisors and client-facing specialists who need to align stakeholders, gain approval or secure cooperation. Participants practise stakeholder mapping, matching evidence and message framing to decision-makers, and handling objections in in-person, digital and hybrid conversations.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who need cooperation, approval, or action from people whose priorities differ from their own. It focuses on everyday workplace influence rather than formal negotiation practice.
modules: Ladder of Inference for Persuasive Dialogue
prerequisites: Working familiarity with routine workplace communication is useful. No coding or specialist software is required; exercises use written scenarios and course worksheets.
